title: Latency/Quality margin audit for eviction and packing policies
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Run a focused audit that measures the operational margin (degradation envelope) between acceptable latency SLOs and measured quality regressions when varying eviction heuristics and microbatch/packing parameters. Scope covers: prefix eviction TTL and size thresholds, packing window (ms) and max tokens, microbatch size distribution, and combined effects with quantized model variants. Produce a prescriptive set of safe-config ranges, automated regression triggers, and a simple canary checklist for console rollouts. Deliverables: (1) dataset slices and golden prompts for quality-sensitivity signals, (2) latency-quality frontier plots and a small decision matrix for product/SEs, (3) a playbook for automated rollback triggers tied to eval metrics and P99 latency safety margin.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Aisha M: Initial kickoff with Runtime and Evals teams. Agreed on target SLOs: 95th latency < 120ms for hosted tier, quality delta threshold set to 2% BLEU-equivalent on our prompt set. Linked baseline dashboard.

2026-02-25 - Liam C: Spiked on synthetic warm vs cold traffic. Observed microbatch size 4 reduces P50 but increases P99 by ~18ms under tail. Uploaded traces to: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/eviction-audit-2026-02-25

2026-03-02 - Priya G (Evals): Generated slice-driven golden prompt set (3k prompts across 6 slices: short-complete, long-prefix, dialogue-context, code, extraction, factual). Saved in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1AuditGoldens

2026-03-05 - Engineering review: Decided to test three eviction strategies: LRU-derived TTL, size-threshold eviction, and hybrid prefix-preservation (protect top-k prefixes). Also to include a microbatch packing policy that limits max latency contribution per request.

2026-03-08 - QA: Ran batch of 1.2M requests through staging model variant runtime-1.21-quant8; found quality regressions localized to 'long-prefix' slice when TTL < 8 tokens. Linked results PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

2026-03-10 - Liam C: Created draft decision matrix and proposed safe-config ranges. Request PM review before adding automatic alert thresholds. Draft doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RUNTIME/Degradation+Envelope+Audit
